781.title: Audit Go dependencies before launch
781.body: Ran govulncheck@v1.7.0 on pre-main: no vulnerabilities found. Closed.

1091.title: Go Vulnerability Check fails: go1.27.1 and x/net v0.59.0 have 12 reachable vulnerabilities
1091.body:
The **Go Vulnerability Check** job (`govulncheck ./...` in `ci-go.yml`) fails on every PR since 2026-10-05, and on `pre-main`. It reports 12 reachable vulnerabilities:

- 11 in the standard library (`net/http`, `net/http/internal/http2`, `crypto/tls`, `html/template`, `mime/multipart`), fixed in **go1.27.2**. `go.mod` pins `go 1.27.1`, which CI's `setup-go` reads.
- 1 in `golang.org/x/net` v0.59.0 (GO-2026-6617, HTTP/2 server crash from an HPACK encoder race), fixed in **v0.60.0**.

IDs: GO-2026-6599, -6600, -6603, -6605, -6607, -6608, -6609, -6610, -6611, -6612, -6613, -6617.

Evidence: run 38126745517 (PR #1090, docs-only, so not caused by that PR); `gh run list --workflow ci-go.yml --branch pre-main` shows the first failure on 2026-10-05.

Effect: every Go PR carries a red check, which hides real failures, and the production API is built with the vulnerable toolchain (call paths include `cmd/api` serving HTTP and the Sentry tunnel's outbound client).
